notes: Full K-means customer-segmentation pipeline (PROC SQL clean/select, PROC CORR, PROC STDIZE range, PROC FASTCLUS maxclusters=3, PROC MEANS by cluster). External class libname MKTG525.CLUSTERDATA replaced with a 25-row in-memory CLUSTERDATA sample matching the read columns (CustomerID, Age, Annual_Income, Spending_Score, Product_Description); only that libname reference was rewritten, clustering logic unchanged. Produces 3 well-separated segments (R-Squared 0.92). standalone.sas folds the sample data into script.sas as a single self-contained file for one-request /v1/quick runs.
